intuition: The target order alternates the first half with the reversed second half.

brute_force.approach: Store all node references in an array and reconnect them from the two ends inward.

optimal.approach: Find the midpoint, reverse the second half in place, then weave nodes from both halves together.

edge_cases: Lists with fewer than three nodes need no meaningful reorder.
Terminate the first half before reversing so the original halves do not remain linked.
The final node may be from either half; ensure no cycle remains.
